title: Customer clarification playbook for multi-output hosted API requests (streaming + tools + structured)
creator: Amaya Chen
description: Create an operational playbook and decision checklist for clarifying and triaging enterprise feature requests that combine chat streaming, function/tool calling, and structured outputs. Goal: reduce back-and-forth with sales/CS, accelerate eligible requests to scoping, and surface engineering/design constraints early.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook document published in Confluence and linked from intake UI
Checklist covers eligibility gates (SLA, data residency, PII, throughput), recommended fallbacks, and sample ask templates
Decision matrix mapping request signals to priority lanes and estimated T-shirt sizing
Presentation and Q&A with sales and solutions engineering completed
comments: 2026-03-01 Amaya Chen (PM): Initial intake pattern observed from 4 enterprise requests in Feb — customers mix streaming + tool calls + structured output; current intake forms treat them as separate flags causing follow-up delays.

2026-03-03 Priya Singh (Eng): Engineering constraints — streaming+tool calls magnifies KV cache and batching complexity. Need to add 'expected stream concurrency' and 'tool API latency' to intake fields.
2026-03-04 Marcel Ruiz (Design): UX suggestion — inline examples and mandatory sample payload should reduce ambiguity. Recommend a 'minimal repro' upload field in intake form.

2026-03-06 Lars Becker (PM-assignee): Draft decision matrix attached; proposing three priority lanes: Fast-track (SLA-compatible), Scoped-POC, Needs-Private. Will run with Solutions Eng for validation.
2026-03-08 Compliance review note: Data residency requirement pushes to Private lane for EU customer with on-prem connectors. Add 'KMS requirement' checkbox to intake.
2026-03-09 Engineering note: Dependency on backend throttling feature (ENG-98421) — if not available, downgrade to Scoped-POC lane. Adding dependency to ticket.
